assets.name: Roof Panel 4 m

pivot.rationale: Origin at minimum X, on the plane where the panel bears on the wall top. The panel's lowest vertex is the eave overhang, which hangs below the bearing plane; using it as the datum would make every correctly placed roof report as buried.

grid.rationale: Plan position is on the bay grid; height is solved from the roof pitch and is not a round number.

allowed_scaling.rationale: Roof pitch must match across every panel or junctions gap.

support.note: grounded means the bearing connector plane, not the panel's lowest vertex, which hangs below on the overhang

connectors.notes: place this point on the wall top plane and the panel is grounded; the eave overhang legitimately hangs below it
